private theorem Roth.weight_le_delta_aux.{u_2} : ∀ {τ : Type u_2} [inst : Fintype τ] {δ : ℝ},
  0 ≤ δ →
    ∀ {r : Option τ → ℕ},
      (∀ (j : τ), ↑(r none) ≤ δ * ↑(r (some j))) →
        ∀ {d : τ →₀ ℕ}, Finsupp.degree d ≤ r none → Roth.weight (r ∘ some) d ≤ δ :=
fun {τ} [Fintype τ] {δ} hδ {r} hratio {d} hd ↦
  if hr : r none = 0 then
    Eq.mpr
      (id
        (congrArg (fun _a ↦ Roth.weight (r ∘ some) _a ≤ δ)
          ((Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff d).mp (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (hr ▸ hd)))))
      (Eq.mpr
        (id
          (congrFun'
            (congrArg LE.le
              (Eq.trans
                (Finset.sum_congr (Eq.refl Finset.univ) fun x a ↦
                  Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg HDiv.hDiv (CharP.cast_eq_zero ℝ 0)) ↑(r (some x)))
                    (zero_div ↑(r (some x))))
                Finset.sum_const_zero))
            δ))
        hδ)
  else
    have hrp :=
      cast (Eq.symm (Eq.trans (congrFun' (congrArg LT.lt (Eq.symm Nat.cast_zero)) ↑(r none)) Nat.cast_lt._simp_1))
        (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hr);
    Trans.trans
      (Trans.trans
        (Trans.trans rfl
          (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j x ↦
            Eq.mpr
              (id
                (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a)
                  (propext (div_le_div_iff₀ (pos_of_mul_pos_right (LT.lt.trans_le hrp (hratio j)) hδ) hrp))))
              (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ↑(d j) * ↑(r none) ≤ _a) (mul_assoc (↑(d j)) δ ↑(r (some j)))))
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hratio j) (Nat.cast_nonneg (d j))))))
        (Eq.mpr
          (id
            (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a = δ * ↑(Finsupp.degree d) / ↑(r none))
              (Eq.symm (Finset.sum_div Finset.univ (fun j ↦ ↑(d j) * δ) ↑(r none)))))
          (Eq.mpr
            (id
              (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a / ↑(r none) = δ * ↑(Finsupp.degree d) / ↑(r none))
                (Eq.symm (Finset.sum_mul Finset.univ (fun i ↦ ↑(d i)) δ))))
            (Eq.mpr
              (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (∑ i, ↑(d i)) * δ / ↑(r none) = δ * ↑_a / ↑(r none)) (Finsupp.degree_eq_sum d)))
              (Eq.mpr
                (id
                  (congrArg (fun _a ↦ (∑ i, ↑(d i)) * δ / ↑(r none) = δ * _a / ↑(r none))
                    (Nat.cast_sum Finset.univ ⇑d)))
                (Eq.mpr
                  (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a / ↑(r none) = (δ * ∑ x, ↑(d x)) / ↑(r none)) (mul_comm (∑ i, ↑(d i)) δ)))
                  (Eq.refl ((δ * ∑ i, ↑(d i)) / ↑(r none)))))))))
      ((div_le_iff₀ hrp).mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (cast (Eq.symm Nat.cast_le._simp_1) hd) hδ))
